name: Arken Audio Codecs v1
description: Portable bounded memory-only WAV, FLAC and AIFF/AIFF-C codecs over a canonical lossless integer PCM model. Integer PCM is preserved exactly; floating-point and compressed WAV/AIFF-C are rejected rather than quantized. The codec never opens files, reads stdio or starts threads.

external_dependencies.reason: Pinned BSD-3-Clause libFLAC library only (no GPL programs, no Ogg, no SIMD) for memory-only FLAC decoding and deterministic encoding.
